### K1
When a decision is recorded, also record the condition that should reopen it, for example "revisit if p95 latency stays above 300 ms for two weeks". A small job watches the condition and surfaces the entry when it fires, so nobody has to remember to look. A log with no triggers tends to decay unread.
Findings used: F1

### Q1
People forget what was decided, or they do not trust the old reasoning, so they argue again. Writing things down more carefully would help.
Findings used: none
